Briar.laning: Don’t stay in the middle of a lane for long when you lack vision. If you push the lane, secure vision so you’re ready to counter Briar’s gank. When ganking with Zac E Elastic Slingshot, charge it behind a wall out of the enemy’s vision. Wait for your ally to draw the enemy forward by trading, then aim for where the enemy is about to be.
Briar.build: Build armor first to deal with Briar’s main damage.
Briar.combo: When Briar charges E Chilling Scream, interrupt it by knocking her up with Zac E Elastic Slingshot, then catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes after landing. If another enemy is nearby, basic attack them to throw both enemies into each other, then follow with Zac R Let’s Bounce! Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter to add damage while bouncing with Zac R Let’s Bounce!
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because either Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack is down. Check her remaining mobility and Briar R Certain Death too. In particular, close the distance with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes before her R is available again.
Briar.fight: Zac has low damage early, so focus on growing safely instead of taking risky fights. If Briar dives in recklessly, take her hits at the front, repeatedly use Zac W Unstable Matter, and immediately collect fallen blobs to heal.
Briar.phase: Briar has high kill involvement early, while Zac has low kill pressure and damage, so safely clear camps and keep up in levels. Once you have items, use Zac W Unstable Matter’s area damage and blob healing to stay in teamfights longer.
Briar.teamfight: When Briar dives in with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, stand in front of your allied carries so she engages on the frontline. When an opening comes, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline to knock them up, then use Zac R Let’s Bounce! to scatter their formation. Afterward, collect blobs to stay alive and use Zac W Unstable Matter whenever it’s available.
Briar.watch: Keep your distance from Briar Q Head Rush, which dashes in, stuns, and lowers your resistances. When Briar starts charging E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with the knockup from Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Don’t fight with your back to a wall, so you can’t be knocked into one and stunned by a fully charged scream. Briar R Certain Death’s bloodstone marks the first champion it hits, so stand in front of your allied carries to take it for them.

Elise.phase: Elise is threatening early because she looks to get ahead with ganks, while Zac has low kill pressure, so grow safely without giving up kills. Once you have items, use Zac W Unstable Matter’s area damage and blob healing to stay in teamfights longer.
Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main damage, and get Spirit Visage early to increase blob healing. Also consider armor, since Elise’s basic attacks account for a significant part of her damage.
Elise.combo: After Elise uses Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock her up, then catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, basic attack an enemy other than the Elise hit by Q to throw them into each other. In teamfights, follow up with Zac R Let’s Bounce! immediately after landing with E, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Elise.escape: Counterengage after confirming that both Elise E Cocoon / Rappel’s Cocoon and E Rappel are down. In particular, immediately after Elise uses Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, close the distance with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
Elise.fight: Avoid risky fights early and clear camps safely to keep up in levels. Right after Elise uses Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, close the distance with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
Elise.laning: Place ample vision early so you don’t give up kills to Elise’s ganks, and don’t push the lane too aggressively when she’s missing. When ganking an allied lane, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of the enemy’s vision and aim for where they’re about to be.
Elise.teamfight: Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot near the enemy backline to knock them up, then immediately use Zac R Let’s Bounce! to scatter their formation. Set up an angle to throw an enemy carry toward your allies with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing with R. After engaging, collect blobs to stay alive.
Elise.watch: If Elise E Cocoon / Rappel’s Cocoon hits you, you’ll be stunned and may then be attacked by Elise in R Spider Form, so dodge by keeping a minion or jungle monster between you and Elise. If Elise transforms with R Spider Form when health has dropped, it is a time to look for a finish, so create distance with Zac E Elastic Slingshot.

Jax.build: Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so don’t build resistance to only one type. If the enemy team’s magic damage is high, get Spirit Visage earlier to increase your healing as well. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on max health, so avoid building only health and consider ways to reduce attack speed to lower his basic-attack-focused damage.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, knock him up with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and follow with Zac R Let’s Bounce! as soon as you land. Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing with Zac R Let’s Bounce! Then, if Zac Q Stretching Strikes hits, auto-attack another enemy to knock both up. If Jax is alone, use Q to slow him.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike, his mobility is down, so close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Right after the stun from Jax E Counter Strike ends, lock Jax down with Zac Q Stretching Strikes and Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t use Zac E Elastic Slingshot to engage; save it for moving out of the stun area.
Jax.fight: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, leave the stun area and wait for the recast to end.
Jax.laning: Zac has low kill pressure early, so clear camps safely and keep up in levels. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of enemy vision. After your ally draws Jax forward, aim for where he’s about to stand. Pressure him with your ally while Jax E Counter Strike is down.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax jumps in with Jax Q Leap Strike and activates Jax E Counter Strike, spread out from your allies to avoid the area stun. As soon as the stun ends, lock Jax down with Zac Q Stretching Strikes and Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If Zac can engage first, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline, scatter their formation with Zac R Let’s Bounce!, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while picking up blobs.
Jax.watch: When Jax closes in with Jax Q Leap Strike, don’t group with nearby allies and get hit by the area stun from Jax E Counter Strike.

Belveth.teamfight: When Bel'Veth W Above and Below is down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline and use Zac R Let’s Bounce! to scatter their formation. After engaging, collect blobs and repeatedly use Zac W Unstable Matter. Look for an angle to use Zac Q Stretching Strikes to throw an enemy carry toward your allies. If an ally dies and leaves Void Coral, back away before Bel'Veth can collect it. Delay the teamfight while Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet’s transformation is active.
Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks you up and resets Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, so sidestep when she closes in. Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom reduces the damage she takes, so wait for it to end instead of dumping Zac W Unstable Matter into her, or interrupt it with the knock-up from Zac E Elastic Slingshot.
Belveth.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom. Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet’s true damage cannot be blocked by resistances, so build health too, and use any means you have to reduce her attack speed.
Belveth.combo: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, then use Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock her up while Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down and follow with Zac R Let’s Bounce! Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing. If another enemy is nearby, catch Bel'Veth with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then basic attack the other enemy to knock both up.
Belveth.escape: Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has a separate cooldown for each direction, so check which way she just dashed. Sidestep Bel'Veth W Above and Below to create an opening, then close the distance with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and follow up with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below, check which direction Bel'Veth Q Void Surge is down in, then engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. After landing, lock her down with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. When Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, interrupt it with a knockup or attack after it ends instead of dumping your damage into it.
Belveth.laning: Zac has low damage and kill pressure early, so clear camps safely and keep up in levels. If you see a chance to slow Bel'Veth’s growth before she builds stacks, steal her camps. For ganks, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of the enemy’s vision and aim for where they’re about to be.
Belveth.phase: Bel'Veth is weak early, but Zac also has low damage early, so safely keep up in levels while looking for chances to slow her growth. Bel'Veth’s stacks are permanent and make her stronger over time, so you become less favored as the game goes on.

Evelynn.combo: When Evelynn R Last Caress is down, approach with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock her up, then catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, use a basic attack to throw Evelynn, who you caught with Q, into that enemy and knock them up. When engaging in a teamfight, follow up with Zac R Let’s Bounce! immediately after landing with E, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against Evelynn’s main damage and get Spirit Visage early. Spirit Visage also increases how much Zac heals from blobs. Evelynn E Whiplash deals damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on building a lot of health alone.
Evelynn.escape: Don’t chase just because Evelynn E Whiplash is down. The chance to approach with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and land Zac Q Stretching Strikes is when Evelynn R Last Caress is also down and hasn’t come back yet. If you have the mark from Evelynn W Allure, back away before the charm matures.
Evelynn.fight: Don’t take a fight while the mark from Evelynn W Allure is maturing; back away. If Evelynn R Last Caress is not available, look for a chance to close the distance with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. During the fight, collect blobs immediately to heal and use Zac W Unstable Matter whenever it’s available.
Evelynn.laning: Clear camps safely and keep up in levels early. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of the enemy’s vision and aim for where the enemy is about to be.
Evelynn.phase: Once you have items, use Zac W Unstable Matter’s area damage and blob healing to keep teamfights going longer.
Evelynn.teamfight: Evelynn targets backline carries, so stay within your allies’ vision to protect them and keep Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot available to use on Evelynn. If she engages, knock her up and catch her. While the fight continues, collect blobs and repeatedly use Zac W Unstable Matter. Decide whether to chase and engage with the knowledge that Evelynn can escape with Evelynn R Last Caress.
Evelynn.watch: If you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, she’s preparing to charm you, so back away before it matures and alert your allies. When your health is low, watch out for the increased damage from Evelynn R Last Caress and don’t stay where you lack vision.

Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, it stuns you and lets Amumu close the gap, so dodge it with a minion or jungle monster between you. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns everyone in a large area, so keep your distance before Amumu gets close and avoid grouping with your allies. Even after Amumu closes in, manage your distance so you don’t take Amumu W Despair’s max-health-based damage for long.
Amumu.build: If Amumu’s magic damage is a problem, build Spirit Visage early for magic resistance and more healing from Zac P Cell Division’s blobs. Amumu W Despair deals damage based on your max health, so mix in magic resistance instead of building only health. Amumu P Cursed Touch’s true damage cannot be reduced by resistances.
Amumu.combo: After Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock enemies up, then immediately follow with Zac R Let’s Bounce! Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing with Zac R Let’s Bounce! If two or more enemies are close together, hit one with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then basic attack another to knock both up.
Amumu.escape: The window to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot is after Amumu Q Bandage Toss and Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy are down. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so after you catch him and follow up with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, he’ll have a hard time getting away without using Flash.
Amumu.fight: Avoid risky fights early, and engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot after Amumu Q Bandage Toss or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so follow up with Zac Q Stretching Strikes once you catch him.
Amumu.laning: Zac has low damage and kill pressure early, so clear camps safely and keep up in levels. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of the enemy’s vision, and aim for where they’re about to be. When you need to watch out for Amumu Q Bandage Toss, keep a minion or jungle monster between you.
Amumu.teamfight: If Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from your allies and avoid fighting in narrow passages. Make him use it, then land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline to knock them up and use Zac R Let’s Bounce! to scatter their formation. After engaging, collect blobs to stay alive and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter.

Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so close the distance with Zac E Elastic Slingshot after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. Brand Q Sear stuns enemies who are ablaze, so if you’re ablaze, dodge the projectile before engaging.
Brand.build: Brand deals magic damage, so build magic resistance. If the enemy’s magic damage is high, build Spirit Visage early to also increase healing from your blobs.
Brand.combo: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the backline to knock enemies up, then immediately follow with Zac R Let’s Bounce! to scatter their formation. Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing with Zac R Let’s Bounce! If another enemy is near Brand, hit Brand with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then basic attack the other enemy to knock both up.
Brand.fight: Look to engage just after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. Charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of sight, land where Brand is about to be, and catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If you’re ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear’s stun first.
Brand.laning: Clear camps safely and keep up in levels early. For a gank, wait for your ally to draw Brand forward by trading, then charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of the enemy’s vision. Avoid standing near burning minions, since Brand E Conflagration can spread from them.
Brand.phase: Zac has low kill pressure and damage early, so clear camps safely and keep up in levels. After you build items, Zac W Unstable Matter’s area damage and blob healing improve your staying power in teamfights.
Brand.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from your allies to prevent Brand E Conflagration and Brand R Pyroclasm from spreading between you. Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the backline where Brand is, then use Zac R Let’s Bounce! to scatter their formation. Afterward, collect blobs immediately and use Zac W Unstable Matter whenever it’s available to stay alive.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your max health, and consecutive hits from his abilities build stacks that explode. Dodge his first ability, and if you’re ablaze, move out of the path of Brand Q Sear’s projectile or hide behind a minion. In teamfights, spread out from your allies to prevent Brand E Conflagration from spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm from bouncing between you.

Khazix.fight: Don't trade with Kha'Zix while isolated; stay close to your allies. Right after Kha'Zix E Leap is down, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. During the fight, pick up blobs immediately to heal and use Zac W Unstable Matter whenever it comes off cooldown.
Khazix.build: Kha'Zix's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Keep in mind that armor can't block the magic damage from Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat.
Khazix.combo: When Kha'Zix E Leap is down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up, then immediately follow with Zac R Let's Bounce! Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing. If you hit Kha'Zix with Zac Q Stretching Strikes and there is another enemy to attack, basic attack that enemy to throw the two into each other. If there isn't another enemy, use Zac Q Stretching Strikes to slow Kha'Zix.
Khazix.escape: The opening for Zac is right after Kha'Zix uses E Leap to engage. Close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and counter with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. However, if Kha'Zix E Leap is evolved and he has already helped kill one of your allies, its cooldown may reset, so reassess your opening to counter-engage.
Khazix.laning: Farm camps safely and keep up in levels early, and don't let Kha'Zix figure out where you're farming alone. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall without vision and aim for where the enemy is about to stand. Secure vision in river and jungle entrance brushes to watch for Kha'Zix P Unseen Threat.
Khazix.phase: Zac has low kill pressure and damage early, so focus on safe growth. From midgame onward, once two or more evolutions have been accumulated, stop acting alone. Once Zac has accumulated items, use the area damage from Zac W Unstable Matter and blob healing to keep fighting in teamfights.
Khazix.teamfight: Fight grouped with your allies in narrow areas where you have vision, and don't let your backline damage dealers get isolated. If Kha'Zix disappears with R Void Assault, use Zac W Unstable Matter along his expected approach path and control him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes as he reappears. When engaging, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline, scatter their formation with Zac R Let's Bounce!, and survive by picking up blobs.
Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals more damage when you're isolated, so fight near your allies. If Kha'Zix engages with E Leap, counter with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If Kha'Zix vanishes with R Void Assault, use an area ability along his expected approach path and control him as soon as he reappears.

Fiddlesticks.watch: If Fiddlesticks has been out of sight for a while, watch for Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm from a brush. If you see him channeling, interrupt with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot; if you can't, move out of range. Fiddlesticks' abilities can fear you from out of sight, so don't group up and enter narrow paths without vision.
Fiddlesticks.build: Fiddlesticks deals magic damage, so build magic resistance. If the enemy team’s magic damage is high, get Spirit Visage earlier to increase Zac’s blob healing as well.
Fiddlesticks.combo: When Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm is down, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up, then follow with Zac R Let’s Bounce! Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing. If another enemy is nearby, grab Fiddlesticks with Zac Q Stretching Strikes and auto-attack the other enemy to knock them both up.
Fiddlesticks.escape: Watch for Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and the silence from Fiddlesticks E Reap, and save Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot to interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts, interrupt it with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot to reduce his healing and chance to recast it. Pick up blobs as soon as they drop during fights, and use Zac W Unstable Matter often.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Early on, don’t force kills. Clear camps safely and keep up in levels. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of enemy vision and aim for where Fiddlesticks is about to stand. Keep the brush behind the lane warded, and don’t walk past an unchecked Scarecrow Effigy.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Once you have more items, use the area damage from Zac W Unstable Matter and blob healing to sustain through long team fights.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Secure vision in the brushes and entrances near objectives, and spread out so Fiddlesticks’s area abilities don’t hit you together. Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline and use Zac R Let’s Bounce! to scatter their formation, then survive by picking up blobs. If you can’t interrupt Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, don’t keep fighting inside its range.

RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai goes underground with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, watch your step and move toward open ground. If you dodge the knock-up as she emerges, using Zac E Elastic Slingshot, Rek'Sai loses her way to catch you. If you're hit by Rek'Sai's ranged poke while she's burrowed, Rek'Sai R Void Rush can follow, so stay close to your allies.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Resistance doesn’t reduce the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, so get some health too, but don’t invest heavily in health alone because Rek'Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your maximum health. If you can lower her attack speed, you’ll take less basic attack damage following Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker.
RekSai.combo: If you can engage before Rek'Sai R Void Rush returns, knock her up with Zac E Elastic Slingshot, then hit her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes to prevent her escape. If another enemy is beside Rek'Sai, catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then basic attack the other enemy to throw them both up. When engaging in a teamfight, follow Zac E Elastic Slingshot with Zac R Let's Bounce! as soon as you land, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
RekSai.escape: When only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, so don’t rush your engage. Look especially for a chance to approach with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes before Rek'Sai R Void Rush returns. If you also dodge the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, she loses her way to catch you.
RekSai.fight: Clear camps safely and keep up in levels early so Rek'Sai doesn’t get a kill from a gank. If you dodge the knock-up from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow or her R Void Rush has not yet come off cooldown, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot.
RekSai.laning: Don’t push the lane recklessly or move alone through areas without vision. If you spot a tunnel entrance from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel near a lane or in your jungle, walk over it to destroy it. For ganks, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot from behind a wall outside enemy vision, then aim for where the enemy will soon be standing after your ally draws them forward.
RekSai.phase: Rek'Sai is dangerous early as she tries to build an advantage through ganks, so avoid giving up kills and level up safely.
RekSai.teamfight: Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot toward the enemy backline to knock them up, then immediately use Zac R Let's Bounce! to disrupt their formation. Move toward the backline while bouncing with Zac R Let's Bounce!, keep using Zac W Unstable Matter, and look for an angle to throw an enemy carry toward your team with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. After engaging, collect dropped blobs to survive.

Diana.build: Build magic resistance against Diana’s damage and get Spirit Visage early. Spirit Visage grants magic resistance and also helps Zac P Cell Division heal more from blobs.
Diana.combo: When Diana’s mobility is down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock her up, then immediately use Zac R Let’s Bounce! Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter and collect blobs while bouncing. If another enemy is close, hit Diana with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then basic attack the other enemy to throw them into each other.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark, she has no way to return, so catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush can dash in again, so create distance instead of trying to catch her.
Diana.fight: After dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike, bait out Diana E Lunar Rush, then close the distance with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Follow up by catching her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. During the fight, collect blobs immediately and repeatedly use Zac W Unstable Matter.
Diana.laning: Zac has low kill pressure early, so clear camps safely and keep up in levels. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of the enemy’s vision and aim for where Diana is about to be. It’s safer to engage after your ally draws Diana forward by trading.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out based on the angle of engagement and secure vision on the flanks so several allies aren’t pulled in by Diana R Moonfall together. Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline to knock them up, then use Zac R Let’s Bounce! to scatter their formation. After engaging, collect blobs to stay alive and repeatedly use Zac W Unstable Matter.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge sideways instead of only moving backward. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush can dash in again, so leave the area. Don’t fight close to Diana right after she activates Diana W Pale Cascade; wait until the orbs and shield are gone.

Ekko.build: Ekko’s main damage is magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Getting Spirit Visage early lets you gain magic resistance and more healing from Zac P Cell Division’s blobs.
Ekko.combo: If Ekko E Phase Dive is down and before Ekko R Chronobreak is available again, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up, then follow with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, hit Ekko with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then basic attack the other enemy to throw both into each other and knock them up. If Ekko is alone, use Zac Q Stretching Strikes to slow him and follow with basic attacks.
Ekko.escape: Don’t engage just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down. Close the distance with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and follow up with Zac Q Stretching Strikes during the window when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, his mobility is down, so knock him up with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot to pressure him into using Ekko R Chronobreak. If you see the tell for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid the area. Fight in earnest after Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.laning: Early on, clear camps safely and keep up in levels instead of forcing kills. For a gank, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of the enemy’s vision and aim for where Ekko is about to be. Engaging after your ally trades and draws Ekko forward is safer.
Ekko.phase: Zac has low kill pressure and damage early, so focus on growing safely.
Ekko.teamfight: Avoid the area where the tell for Ekko W Parallel Convergence is still visible. Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline and use Zac R Let’s Bounce! to scatter their formation. When Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive and has no mobility left, lock him down with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. After engaging, collect blobs to stay alive and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while Zac R Let’s Bounce! is active.
Ekko.watch: Ekko W Parallel Convergence stuns and shields after its tell appears, so stay out of the marked area while the tell is visible. Ekko Q Timewinder hits harder on the way back, so move out of its return path. If you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don’t recklessly chase him even when health is low.

Gragas.build: Build magic resistance over armor to counter Gragas Q Barrel Roll, W Drunken Rage, and E Body Slam. Getting Spirit Visage earlier gives you both magic resistance and more healing from Zac’s blobs. Since Gragas W Drunken Rage deals damage based on your max health, consider movement speed to get out of its telegraphed area instead of stacking only health.
Gragas.combo: When Gragas E Body Slam is down, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up, then use Zac R Let’s Bounce! as soon as you land. Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing. If two or more enemies are grouped, hit one with Zac Q Stretching Strikes and auto-attack another to knock them both up.
Gragas.escape: Right after you make Gragas use E Body Slam is your chance to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Gragas E Body Slam comes back quickly if it collides with an enemy, so only chase a fleeing Gragas when you can secure the kill. When you need to escape, keep moving and toss Zac Q Stretching Strikes backward to slow your pursuer.
Gragas.fight: As soon as Gragas E Body Slam is down, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and land Zac Q Stretching Strikes. While Gragas drinks with W Drunken Rage, don’t commit heavy damage; attack after the effect ends. Pick up dropped blobs immediately during fights and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter.
Gragas.laning: Early on, clear camps safely and keep up in levels. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of enemy vision and aim for where Gragas is about to stand. It’s safer to engage after your ally draws Gragas forward through a trade.
Gragas.phase: Zac has low kill pressure early, so focus on safe growth. If you hold your formation and survive early and midgame fights, Gragas’s weak sustained damage and Zac’s blob healing become useful later.
Gragas.teamfight: Don’t leave your backline allies alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam, and position so Gragas R Explosive Cask can’t scatter your formation. To engage, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline and disrupt their formation with Zac R Let’s Bounce! Look for an angle to toss an enemy damage dealer toward your team with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and survive by picking up dropped blobs.
Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move outside its radius. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you near a barrel, you can be hit by both abilities, so be especially careful in narrow passages without vision. When Gragas has R Explosive Cask available, don’t stand with your back to the enemy team or a turret.

Graves.build: Buy Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first because Graves’s main damage sources—Graves P New Destiny, Graves Q End of the Line, and Graves R Collateral Damage—deal physical damage.
Graves.combo: After Graves uses his mobility ability, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up, then immediately follow with Zac R Let’s Bounce! to scatter their formation. Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing with Zac R Let’s Bounce!, and grab Graves with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, auto-attack them to toss both enemies into each other. If Graves is alone, use Zac Q Stretching Strikes to slow him.
Graves.escape: Don’t engage just because Graves E Quickdraw is down. Your chance is when Graves R Collateral Damage is also down and before it comes back, so close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and grab him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
Graves.fight: Trade back or create distance while Graves reloads after firing two shots. Fight in open areas, and walk over Zac P Cell Division blobs dropped during the fight to heal.
Graves.laning: Zac has low kill pressure early, so clear camps safely and keep up in levels. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of enemy vision. After your ally draws Graves forward through a trade, aim for where he’s about to stand.
Graves.phase: Zac has low kill pressure early, so level safely while pressuring Graves with your allies to deny him time to build stacks. Graves gets harder to deal with as his stacks build, so it’s better to put him behind early.
Graves.teamfight: Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot near the enemy backline to knock them up, then scatter their formation with Zac R Let’s Bounce! If you grab Graves, look for an angle to toss him toward your allies with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. Use Zac W Unstable Matter whenever it’s ready and survive by picking up blobs.
Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall and face him in open areas. If Graves W Smoke Screen traps you, leave by the shortest route, then close back in with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Graves P New Destiny basic attacks are blocked by the first unit hit, so keep a minion or ally between you and him.

Hecarim.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and E Devastating Charge. Hecarim W Spirit of Dread and R Onslaught of Shadows deal magic damage, which armor can’t block.
Hecarim.combo: When you need to stop Hecarim’s movement, slow him first with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up. If another enemy is nearby, auto-attack that enemy to toss the Q-hit Hecarim and that enemy into each other. Then follow with Zac R Let’s Bounce! to maintain the slow, and use Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Hecarim.escape: If only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down, he can still escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, so don’t rush your engage. Especially before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and block his escape with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, disrupt Hecarim’s movement with the slow from Zac Q Stretching Strikes or the knock-up from Zac E Elastic Slingshot to reduce both his approach and damage.
Hecarim.laning: Early on, clear camps safely and keep up in levels. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of enemy vision. After your ally draws the enemy forward through a trade, aim for where they’re about to stand.
Hecarim.phase: Once you have more items, use the area damage from Zac W Unstable Matter and blob healing to sustain through team fights.
Hecarim.teamfight: Your allies should spread out so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t catch several of them. When Hecarim charges in, Zac should stop his movement with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot. To engage, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline and scatter their formation with Zac R Let’s Bounce!
Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the farther he has run, so move close to your allies when he turns and starts charging. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear grouped allies all at once, so spread out before the fight begins.

Ivern.build: Ivern’s own damage is low; the greater danger is his allies following up on Ivern Q Rootcaller and Ivern R Daisy!, so consider tenacity first. If the enemy team has high magic damage, get Spirit Visage earlier for magic resistance and more healing from Zac P Cell Division blobs.
Ivern.combo: When Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed has burst, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock enemies up, then follow with Zac R Let’s Bounce! Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing and move toward the backline. If you can hit one enemy with Zac Q Stretching Strikes and auto-attack another, toss them into each other to knock them up.
Ivern.escape: Ivern Q Rootcaller is his means of movement, so close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot right after you make him use it. Then grab him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes to reduce his chance to escape. If the target is already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed, wait for the shield to burst before engaging.
Ivern.fight: Engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot after Ivern Q Rootcaller is down and Ivern E Triggerseed has burst. Zac’s main magic damage is effective against Ivern’s low magic resistance, but interrupt the ally he’s shielding instead of chasing Ivern deep. Pick up blobs immediately during fights and use Zac W Unstable Matter whenever it’s ready.
Ivern.laning: Early on, clear camps safely and keep up in levels. Ward camps Ivern has seeded to read his clear path. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of enemy vision. After your ally draws the enemy forward, aim for where they’re about to stand. Don’t casually walk past brushes that suddenly appear from Ivern W Brushmaker.
Ivern.phase: Zac has low damage and kill pressure early, so clear camps safely and focus on scaling.
Ivern.teamfight: While Ivern Q Rootcaller is down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline and scatter their formation with Zac R Let’s Bounce! Look for an angle to toss an enemy damage dealer toward your allies with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If Ivern R Daisy! blocks your path, use non-targeted abilities toward enemies behind her carefully.
Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller roots you, his allies can dash in, so keep a minion or terrain between you and him before he casts it. Don’t engage a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed until the shield bursts. If Ivern R Daisy! starts hitting you repeatedly, reposition to avoid her knock-up.

JarvanIV.build: Later, consider effects that reduce attack speed to counter basic attacks and attack speed.
JarvanIV.combo: When engaging in a team fight, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline and cast Zac R Let’s Bounce! right after landing. Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
JarvanIV.escape: Especially when you see the flag, dodge the Q engage first, then engage.
JarvanIV.fight: Right after taking that attack, you can trade back with Zac W Unstable Matter and pick up blobs.
JarvanIV.laning: Zac has low damage and kill pressure early, so clear camps safely and keep up in levels. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall out of vision and aim for where the enemy is about to stand.
JarvanIV.teamfight: Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline to knock them up, then scatter their formation with Zac R Let’s Bounce! Use Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing with R, and survive by picking up blobs immediately.

Karthus.build: All of Karthus’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance. If the enemy team’s magic damage is high, get Spirit Visage earlier for magic resistance and more healing from Zac P Cell Division blobs.
Karthus.combo: Charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot out of vision, land on Karthus, and knock him up, then hit him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, auto-attack them to toss both enemies into each other. If Karthus is alone, use Zac Q Stretching Strikes to slow him. In team fights, follow up with Zac R Let’s Bounce! right after landing, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Karthus.escape: Karthus has no ability to create distance on his own, so look for chances to approach with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Engage when Karthus W Wall of Pain is down or you can enter without stepping on the wall, then grab him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes after landing.
Karthus.fight: Early on, don’t force kills. Clear camps safely and keep up in levels. Close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot along a path that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain, then grab him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
Karthus.laning: When ganking, first find a place out of enemy vision behind a wall to charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot. After your ally draws Karthus forward through a trade, aim for where he’s about to stand and land.
Karthus.teamfight: Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot near Karthus on the enemy backline to knock him up, then scatter their formation with Zac R Let’s Bounce! Look for an angle to toss Karthus toward your allies with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while picking up blobs. Even after you kill Karthus, Karthus P Death Defied keeps dealing damage, so move away from his corpse immediately and reposition.
Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals increased damage if it hits you alone, so walk out of the marked blast area and, if possible, stand overlapping an ally or minion. Karthus W Wall of Pain lowers your magic resistance and slows you, so move outside the wall to reduce the damage from the following Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus R Requiem. After killing Karthus, move away from his corpse immediately to avoid the attacks from Karthus P Death Defied.

Kayn.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, Kayn W Blade's Reach, and Kayn R Umbral Trespass. If Kayn has transformed into the Darkin and the duel is dragging on, consider anti-heal after building resistances.
Kayn.combo: While Kayn R Umbral Trespass is down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up, then hit Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is near Kayn, hit that enemy with a basic attack to throw the two into each other. Follow with Zac R Let's Bounce! to scatter their formation, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Kayn.escape: Don't rush in when only Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down, since Kayn can still use R Umbral Trespass to escape. Look for an opening before Kayn R Umbral Trespass is back up, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot, then follow with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If Kayn uses E Shadow Step to travel along a wall, you can interrupt him immediately with the knock-up from Zac E Elastic Slingshot.
Kayn.fight: Zac has low damage early, so farm camps safely and keep up in levels. Before Kayn R Umbral Trespass is back up, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
Kayn.laning: When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot from behind a wall outside the enemy's vision, aiming for where Kayn is about to stand. If you see Kayn use E Shadow Step, you can interrupt it with the knock-up from Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If your allies see the warning marker at the edge of the wall Kayn is in, have them stop trading and retreat toward their turret.
Kayn.phase: Kayn is weak before transforming, but Zac also has little kill pressure and damage early, so avoid risky fights and focus on leveling safely. Delay Kayn's transformation by pressuring objectives without giving up early kills.
Kayn.watch: Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach's line-shaped hitbox to reduce the risk of being caught by Kayn R Umbral Trespass from long range. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about fighting him when you have only stacked health.

Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If the duel drags on, consider anti-heal next to counter the healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite. Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy deals magic damage based on your current health, so be careful about stacking only health.
Kindred.combo: When Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is down, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock Kindred up, then catch them with Zac Q Stretching Strikes and disrupt their movement. If another enemy is nearby, basic attack that enemy to throw them and the Kindred caught by Q into each other and knock them up. In a teamfight, follow up immediately after landing with Zac R Let's Bounce!, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Kindred.escape: Don't rush in when only Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down, since Kindred can escape with their remaining mobility. In particular, before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is back up is an opening to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. After engaging, hit Kindred with Zac Q Stretching Strikes to prevent them from getting away.
Kindred.fight: Zac has low kill pressure early, so farm camps safely and keep up in levels. After Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy is down, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and disrupt Kindred's movement with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. During the fight, pick up dropped blobs right away to heal and use Zac W Unstable Matter repeatedly.
Kindred.laning: When ganking, first find a spot behind a wall outside the enemy's vision where you can charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot. After your ally draws the enemy forward with a trade, fly toward where the enemy is about to stand. Clear or ward near jungle camps marked by Kindred P Mark of the Kindred first to delay Kindred from claiming the mark.
Kindred.phase: Kindred is vulnerable to pressure early, but Zac also has low kill pressure and damage, so focus on safe growth while contesting marked camps. Later, use Zac's area damage and blob healing, and delay Kindred from claiming Kindred P Mark of the Kindred to limit their damage and range growth.
Kindred.teamfight: Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the backline where Kindred is to knock them up, then scatter the formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! Disrupt Kindred's movement and keep them outside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, while using Zac W Unstable Matter repeatedly as you pick up blobs. When Kindred R Lamb's Respite is active, even low-health allies can survive inside its zone, so go in together and heal when it ends.
Kindred.watch: If Kindred E Mounting Dread marks you, create distance or break line of sight so you don't take successive hits. Its damage increases as your health gets lower, so use Zac Q Stretching Strikes to slow Kindred as you escape. Kindred can use Q Dance of Arrows frequently inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so don't stay close for long.

LeeSin.build: Buy armor items first against the damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor can't block the damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. If Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will's omnivamp makes a skirmish drag on, consider anti-heal.
LeeSin.combo: Before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is back up, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up, then catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, basic attack an enemy other than the one hit by Q to throw them into each other. When starting a teamfight, follow up with Zac R Let's Bounce! immediately after Zac E Elastic Slingshot lands, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
LeeSin.escape: Engage when Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike has missed or while it is unavailable. If only Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is down, he can still escape with his other mobility ability, so track whether both mobility abilities have been used. When retreating, throw Zac Q Stretching Strikes backward as you move to slow pursuers.
LeeSin.fight: If you meet Lee Sin in the jungle early, don't accept a duel; back away. When Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or is unavailable, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
LeeSin.laning: Before ganking, find a spot behind a wall outside the enemy's vision where you can charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot. After your ally draws the enemy forward with a trade, land where the enemy is about to stand. If you expect a Lee Sin gank, keep a minion wave between you and Lee Sin to block the line for Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so Zac should farm camps safely and keep up in levels.
LeeSin.teamfight: Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline to knock them up, then immediately scatter their formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! Look for an angle to throw an enemy damage dealer toward your allies with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while picking up blobs. Before engaging, keep your distance from allies so you aren't knocked up alongside an ally hit by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.
LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin can cross walls with W Safeguard / Iron Will, so keep your distance even near walls without vision. Before a teamfight, spread out so you don't collide with an ally kicked by Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage.

Lillia.build: Build magic resistance first against Lillia's main magic damage. If the enemy's magic damage is high, buy Spirit Visage earlier to increase healing from Zac P Cell Division's blobs as well. Resistances can't reduce the true damage from Lillia Q Blooming Blows, but Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough scales with maximum health, so avoid stacking a lot of health alone.
Lillia.combo: When Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock her up, then follow with Zac Q Stretching Strikes to catch her. If another enemy is nearby, hit that enemy with a basic attack after landing Zac Q Stretching Strikes to throw them into each other. In a teamfight, follow Zac E Elastic Slingshot's landing immediately with Zac R Let's Bounce! to disrupt the formation, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Lillia.escape: The opening to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot is right after you've made Lillia use W Watch Out! Eep!. Dodge Lillia's abilities and close the gap when she has no movement speed stacks. While charging Zac E Elastic Slingshot, you may be exposed to poke, including the slow from Lillia E Swirlseed, so set up your angle behind a wall outside vision.
Lillia.fight: Lillia gets faster each time she hits an ability, so dodge her poke and wait until she has no movement speed stacks. Right after Lillia uses W Watch Out! Eep!, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. Once close, pick up blobs right away and use Zac W Unstable Matter whenever it comes off cooldown.
Lillia.laning: Farm camps safely and keep up in levels early. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall outside the enemy's vision and aim for where Lillia is about to stand. If you don't know where Lillia is, don't pass straight through narrow jungle entrances or river paths where it's hard to dodge Lillia E Swirlseed.
Lillia.phase: Zac has low kill pressure and damage early, so focus on safe growth and don't let Lillia repeatedly hit you with abilities and build movement speed stacks.
Lillia.teamfight: Save one crowd control ability to catch Lillia when she comes in from the side. If you engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot, land near the enemy backline and disrupt their formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! Then look for an angle to throw an enemy damage dealer toward your allies with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter as you pick up blobs.
Lillia.watch: If Lillia Q Blooming Blows or Lillia E Swirlseed hits you, you'll be a target for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, so dodge them even when you have plenty of health. If you're affected by Lillia R Lilting Lullaby, move to a safe place during the drowsy period before you fall asleep. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! begin its cast, move sideways to avoid the center.

MasterYi.build: Master Yi E Wuju Style's true damage can't be reduced by resistances, so build health too. Attack speed reduction slows both his basic attack damage and the cooldown reduction on Master Yi Q Alpha Strike.
MasterYi.combo: Once Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up, then catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, basic attack that enemy to throw the two into each other and knock them up; if Master Yi is alone, use Zac Q Stretching Strikes to slow him. Follow with Zac R Let's Bounce!, pressing Zac W Unstable Matter between bounces.
MasterYi.escape: The opening to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot is the moment Master Yi lands after you make him use Q Alpha Strike. Catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and if another enemy is nearby, follow with a basic attack to knock them up. If Master Yi activates W Meditate, interrupt the channel with Zac E Elastic Slingshot's knock-up.
MasterYi.fight: Zac has low damage and kill pressure early, so farm camps safely and keep up in levels. After Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter. During the fight, pick up dropped blobs immediately to restore health and reduce Zac W Unstable Matter's cooldown.
MasterYi.laning: When ganking, first find a spot behind a wall outside the enemy's vision where you can charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If your ally draws Master Yi forward with a trade, engage toward where he is about to be, not where he is now. If Master Yi Q Alpha Strike has already been used, his landing is your chance to close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot.
MasterYi.phase: Zac has low kill pressure and damage early, but Master Yi is also weak in the jungle and at ganking, so safely keep up in levels and secure early objectives you can take. Zac's area damage and blob healing become strong once he has items, but Master Yi also gets stronger as the game goes on, so don't put off building an early lead.
MasterYi.teamfight: Move together so you don't leave an ally alone for Master Yi. When Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends and he lands, hit him with the knock-up from Zac E Elastic Slingshot. After engaging, survive by picking up blobs and using Zac W Unstable Matter repeatedly.
MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can't be targeted while casting Q Alpha Strike, so use Zac Q Stretching Strikes right after he lands. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows don't affect him, so don't rely on the slow from Zac R Let's Bounce! to create distance. Basic attacks while Master Yi E Wuju Style is active include true damage, so avoid extended fights where you stay close and take repeated hits.

MonkeyKing.build: Buy armor items first against Wukong's main damage. Armor can't block the magic damage from Wukong E Nimbus Strike, and while you've been hit by Wukong Q Crushing Blow, the effectiveness of your armor is reduced. Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on maximum health, so consider attack speed reduction instead of stacking only health.
MonkeyKing.combo: After confirming Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up and immediately follow with Zac R Let's Bounce! Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing. If another enemy is near Wukong, hit one with Zac Q Stretching Strikes and basic attack the other to throw them into each other.
MonkeyKing.escape: Don't engage when only Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down, since he can escape with Wukong E Nimbus Strike; wait for an opening. Engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot when both mobility abilities and the knock-up from Wukong R Cyclone are down. Wukong R Cyclone can interrupt Zac E Elastic Slingshot with its knock-up, so carefully choose where and when to charge if Wukong R Cyclone is still available.
MonkeyKing.fight: If Wukong closes in with E Nimbus Strike, counter with the slow from Zac Q Stretching Strikes and the magic damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. Wukong builds armor and healing the longer he fights, so trade briefly and disengage. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster is down and Wukong E Nimbus Strike is unavailable, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
MonkeyKing.laning: Zac has low kill pressure and damage early, so farm camps safely and keep up in levels. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall outside the enemy's vision, and after your ally draws Wukong forward, aim for where he is about to stand. If Wukong escapes with W Warrior Trickster, don't waste abilities on the clone left behind.
MonkeyKing.phase: Zac has low kill pressure and damage early, so focus on safe growth. If Wukong engages, use Zac's magic damage to punish his low magic resistance and trade briefly.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: If Wukong R Cyclone is ready, keep your distance from allies so he can't knock up several of you at once. When Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike are down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline to knock them up and scatter their formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! After engaging, keep using Zac W Unstable Matter and survive by picking up blobs.
MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so you can't dodge it while in range, and the follow-up Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor. Don't waste Zac's abilities on the stationary clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster; watch which way the real Wukong moves.

Nidalee.build: Build magic resistance against Nidalee's main damage, and buy Spirit Visage early. Spirit Visage also increases the amount Zac heals from blobs.
Nidalee.combo: When Nidalee W Pounce is down, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock her up and catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, hit Nidalee with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then basic attack the other enemy to throw them into each other. In a teamfight, follow up with Zac R Let's Bounce! immediately after landing, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Nidalee.escape: Engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot right after you've made Nidalee use W Pounce. Nidalee has no crowd control, so check whether Nidalee W Pounce is down when looking for an opening.
Nidalee.fight: Right after Nidalee uses W Pounce is your chance to close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot.
Nidalee.laning: Farm camps safely and keep up in levels early. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall outside the enemy's vision and aim for where the enemy is about to stand. Clear Nidalee W Bushwhack traps in jungle entrances and river ahead of time with a Control Ward or an area ability.
Nidalee.phase: Zac has low kill pressure and damage early, so farm camps safely and keep up in levels.
Nidalee.teamfight: Remember where Nidalee steps out to throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, and when Nidalee W Pounce is down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot near the backline. After landing, scatter their formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! and find an angle to throw an enemy damage dealer toward your allies with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. After engaging, survive by picking up blobs and use Zac W Unstable Matter whenever it comes off cooldown.
Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss hurts more the farther it travels, so be especially careful to dodge it when Nidalee is far away. Also watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack in jungle entrances and river. If a spear or trap hits you and applies Hunt, be ready to counter when Nidalee uses W Pounce to jump in, with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot.

Nocturne.build: Nocturne’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Keep in mind that armor can’t block the magic damage from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, break the spell shield first with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. Then knock him up with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and use Zac R Let's Bounce! right after landing. Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing with Zac R Let's Bounce!
Nocturne.escape: Engage while keeping a mobility tool available to break the tether from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is available, break the spell shield before looking for a knock-up.
Nocturne.fight: Early on, avoid forced fights, clear camps safely, and keep your level even. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is available, break the spell shield first with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot.
Nocturne.laning: When ganking, first find a spot behind a wall outside enemy vision to charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot. After your ally draws Nocturne forward with a trade, jump toward where he’s about to stand. If an ally has been hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, Nocturne can chase along its trail, so group with that ally and respond together.
Nocturne.phase: Early Zac has little kill pressure and damage, so clear camps safely and keep your level even.
Nocturne.teamfight: When the screen darkens from Nocturne R Paranoia, group with your allies so Nocturne can’t pick an isolated target. To engage, land on the enemy back line with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock them up, then scatter the formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! After landing, set up a throw with Zac Q Stretching Strikes that sends an enemy carry toward your allies, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while collecting blobs.
Nocturne.watch: When Nocturne R Paranoia activates, don’t stay isolated; immediately group up with your allies. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is attached to you, use Zac E Elastic Slingshot to create distance so the tether doesn’t hold. If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, don’t flee in a straight line along its trail; turn toward your allies or turret.

Nunu.build: Build magic resistance first against Nunu & Willump’s main damage and get Spirit Visage early. Spirit Visage also improves the healing Zac receives from Zac P Cell Division’s blobs. If healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume prevents you from finishing them off, get Grievous Wounds early.
Nunu.combo: After Nunu & Willump’s crowd control is down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock them up, then follow with Zac R Let's Bounce! Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing. If another enemy is nearby, catch Nunu & Willump with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then basic attack the other enemy to throw them into each other.
Nunu.escape: The window to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot is when Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage are down. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on their own, so catch them with Zac Q Stretching Strikes once you’re close. While charging Zac E Elastic Slingshot, you can be interrupted by a knock-up or root, so first check whether crowd control has been used.
Nunu.fight: Zac deals little damage early, so prioritize safe growth over risky trades. After Nunu & Willump uses crowd control, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and hold them with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. Collect blobs immediately during fights and use Zac W Unstable Matter whenever it’s off cooldown.
Nunu.laning: Clear camps safely and keep up in levels early as Zac. For ganks, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot from behind a wall outside enemy vision, then aim for where the enemy will soon be standing after your ally draws them forward.
Nunu.teamfight: When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, look for an angle to interrupt the channel with the knock-up from Zac E Elastic Slingshot. To engage, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot toward the enemy backline to knock them up, then use Zac R Let's Bounce! to disrupt their formation. Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter and collect blobs to survive.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up, so don’t just run straight back. Sidestep toward the direction the snowball is coming from and retreat to where Nunu just was. If you’re hit by Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage, move immediately before the follow-up root. When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero starts, interrupt the channel with the knock-up from Zac E Elastic Slingshot or leave the area.

Poppy.build: Build armor first to defend against Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about investing heavily in health alone. Don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance just to counter Poppy.
Poppy.combo: Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock her up. Follow immediately with Zac R Let's Bounce! after landing, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing. If at least two enemies are close together, hit one with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then basic attack another enemy to throw them into each other.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use E Heroic Charge is your window to close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait for its duration to end before using Zac E Elastic Slingshot. While Poppy charges R Keeper's Verdict, move to the side.
Poppy.fight: Close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. Once you’re in range, catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes and use Zac W Unstable Matter whenever it’s off cooldown.
Poppy.laning: Zac has little kill pressure early, so clear camps safely and keep up in levels. For ganks, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot from behind a wall outside enemy vision, then aim for where the enemy will soon be standing after your ally draws them forward with a trade. Position in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t pin you against a wall.
Poppy.phase: Zac has little kill pressure and damage early, so clear camps safely and keep up in levels.
Poppy.teamfight: Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, then land Zac E Elastic Slingshot toward the enemy backline. Follow immediately with Zac R Let's Bounce! to disrupt their formation, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing. Look for an angle to throw an enemy carry toward your team with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and survive by collecting blobs.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot; wait until it ends. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, immediately leave the remaining area. When Poppy starts charging R Keeper's Verdict, move to the side. Also check the terrain behind you so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t pin you against a wall.

Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, W Defensive Ball Curl, and R Soaring Slam. Getting Spirit Visage early gives you magic resistance and improves healing from Zac P Cell Division blobs.
Rammus.combo: While Rammus R Soaring Slam is down, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up, then catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is close, basic attack them to make the two collide, then follow with Zac R Let's Bounce! and use Zac W Unstable Matter between bounces.
Rammus.escape: While Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is active, you can’t move or use abilities, so time it to use Zac E Elastic Slingshot as soon as the taunt ends.
Rammus.fight: If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, briefly create distance or target someone else so your basic attacks don’t deal reflected damage to you. After W ends, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot, keep dealing percentage-max-health damage with Zac W Unstable Matter, and collect dropped blobs immediately to survive.
Rammus.laning: Clear camps safely and keep up in levels early. For ganks, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot from behind a wall outside Rammus’s vision, then aim for where the enemy will soon be standing after your ally draws them forward with a trade.
Rammus.phase: Zac has little kill pressure and damage early, so clear camps safely and keep up in levels.
Rammus.teamfight: Instead of spending your damage on the frontline with Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl active, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline and use R Let's Bounce! to disrupt their formation. Look for an angle to throw an enemy carry toward your team with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and keep using W Unstable Matter during R Let's Bounce! After engaging, collect blobs to survive.
Rammus.watch: When Rammus Q Powerball rolls toward you, put minions between you to make him collide with them. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt prevents movement and ability use, so don’t charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot while Rammus is close. Give Rammus R Soaring Slam plenty of space when he rolls in quickly, and leave the landing area immediately.

Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar’s main damage. Armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Rengar W Battle Roar, and its effectiveness is reduced while Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt lowers your armor.
Rengar.combo: After Rengar W Battle Roar is down, knock him up with Zac E Elastic Slingshot, then catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, hit them with a basic attack after landing Zac Q Stretching Strikes to throw the two enemies into each other. To engage in a teamfight, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline and use Zac R Let's Bounce! immediately, then keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Rengar.escape: After avoiding Rengar E Bola Strike, go in with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If Rengar W Battle Roar is down and his resource bar is empty, follow with Zac Q Stretching Strikes to catch him. When disengaging, throw Zac Q Stretching Strikes behind you while moving to slow pursuers.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar’s resource bar is empty. Once you confirm Rengar W Battle Roar is down, catch him with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then keep using Zac W Unstable Matter. Pick up dropped blobs to heal before the enemy can destroy them by stepping on them.
Rengar.laning: Early on, clear camps safely and keep up in levels instead of forcing kills. For ganks, watch routes beside bushes and find a spot behind a wall outside enemy vision to charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Engage toward where the enemy will soon be standing after your ally draws them forward with a trade.
Rengar.phase: Zac has little kill pressure and damage early, so avoid Rengar’s bush leaps and grow safely. Once you’ve built up items, use the area damage from Zac W Unstable Matter and healing from blobs to stay in teamfights longer.
Rengar.teamfight: Position your backline behind the frontline and within vision, and watch for Rengar’s engage. After Rengar goes in and uses Rengar W Battle Roar, catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes and Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If you get a chance to engage first, land on the enemy backline and use Zac R Let's Bounce! to disrupt their formation, while collecting blobs and continuing to use Zac W Unstable Matter.
Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from bushes to build resources, so avoid walking beside bushes when he’s out of sight. When his resource bar is full, Rengar E Bola Strike can root you and Rengar W Battle Roar can remove crowd control, so start fights while the bar is empty. When watching for Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt, don’t roam alone while injured.

Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against Sejuani’s main damage and get Spirit Visage early. Spirit Visage also increases healing from Zac P Cell Division blobs. Sejuani P Fury of the North deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone.
Sejuani.combo: After Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock her up and catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is close, follow Zac Q Stretching Strikes by basic attacking them to throw the two into each other. In teamfights, use Zac R Let's Bounce! to disrupt their formation as soon as you land Zac E Elastic Slingshot, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Sejuani.escape: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is her mobility, so immediately after she uses it, a window opens to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If you’re stunned by Sejuani E Permafrost, create distance as soon as it ends to dodge the follow-up basic attack. Before engaging again, check whether Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down.
Sejuani.fight: Immediately after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If Sejuani P Fury of the North has activated slow immunity, damage her first to give the armor time to wear off.
Sejuani.laning: Clear camps safely and keep up in levels early. For ganks, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot from behind a wall outside enemy vision, then aim for where Sejuani will soon be standing after your ally draws her forward. If Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, use that as your opening to engage.
Sejuani.phase: Both champions have low kill pressure and damage early, so level up safely as Zac while looking for jungle and objective opportunities that can delay Sejuani’s item timings.
Sejuani.teamfight: Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline, not over Sejuani’s frontline, and use Zac R Let's Bounce! to disrupt their formation. Look for an angle to throw an enemy carry toward your team with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter. After engaging, collect blobs immediately to survive, and move so you aren’t staying beside Sejuani and melee allies as stacks of Sejuani E Permafrost build.
Sejuani.watch: When you see the windup for Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or Sejuani R Glacial Prison, move sideways to dodge. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath, get out of range before the second strike. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks from basic attacks by melee allies too, so create distance as the indicator fills.

Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Getting Spirit Visage early gives you magic resistance and improves the healing Zac receives from Zac P Cell Division’s blobs.
Shaco.combo: Once Shaco Q Deceive is down, approach with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up, then hit him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, basic attack them to throw both enemies into each other and knock them up. In teamfights, follow Zac E Elastic Slingshot with Zac R Let's Bounce! as soon as you land, and use Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Shaco.escape: The moment after you make Shaco use Shaco Q Deceive is your window to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If you suspect Shaco W Jack In The Box along an entry path without vision, clear it first before going in.
Shaco.fight: When Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, focus your damage on him with your allies. After making him use Shaco Q Deceive, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and catch him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. Collect blobs immediately during fights and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter.
Shaco.laning: Early on, keep vision at your jungle entrances and clear camps safely so Shaco doesn’t get kills through ganks or invades. For ganks, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot from behind a wall outside enemy vision, then aim for where Shaco will soon be standing after your ally draws him forward. Watch for Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision.
Shaco.phase: Early on, Shaco looks for an advantage through ganks and invades, while Zac has little kill pressure, so level up safely. If you avoid giving up early kills and buy time, Shaco’s dueling power falls off later, while Zac can stay in teamfights longer with area damage and blob healing once he has items.
Shaco.teamfight: Check areas around objectives for suspected Shaco W Jack In The Box before starting a fight. Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline and use Zac R Let's Bounce! to disrupt their formation, then keep using Zac W Unstable Matter and collect blobs to survive. When Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, focus him immediately with your allies. To avoid wasting damage on Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone, identify the real one by watching the health bar’s response.
Shaco.watch: Watch for Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives, and clear them first with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens. After Shaco appears using Q Deceive, adjust your facing so he doesn’t get behind you and hit you with his empowered basic attack. Shaco R Hallucinate’s clone explodes when it dies and leaves boxes behind, so move away from that spot.

Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, and get Spirit Visage early. Spirit Visage also increases Zac’s blob healing. Get some armor too against Shyvana’s basic attacks and Shyvana Q Emberstrike, but avoid building health alone because of her percentage-max-health damage.
Shyvana.combo: To engage, land Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock them up, then follow with Zac R Let's Bounce! Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter and collect blobs to survive while bouncing with Zac R Let's Bounce! When Shyvana is with another enemy, hit her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then basic attack the other enemy to knock both up. If Shyvana is alone, use it to slow her.
Shyvana.escape: The window to engage is when Shyvana’s Fury bar is empty or after she uses Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Don’t try to stop her while she’s flying with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent; hit her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot after she lands. Shyvana has no way to create distance on her own, so when you have an angle to catch her, approach with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and hold her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury bar is empty, and don’t start a fight when it’s full. If Shyvana engages with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, catch her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot after she lands and manage your distance. During fights, pick up dropped blobs immediately to heal and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter.
Shyvana.laning: Zac has little damage and kill pressure early, so clear camps safely and keep up in levels. For ganks, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot from behind a wall outside enemy vision, then aim for where Shyvana will soon be standing after your ally draws her forward. Take opportunities to pressure Shyvana before she builds early growth stacks, but avoid forcing a fight.
Shyvana.phase: Shyvana is weak early without growth stacks, but Zac also has little early kill pressure, so level up safely while looking for chances to pressure her. You’ll fall behind as Shyvana’s permanent growth stacks accumulate, so limit her growth from the start.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out your team so multiple allies aren’t hit by Shyvana’s dragon-form area abilities. Land Zac E Elastic Slingshot on the enemy backline and use Zac R Let's Bounce! to disrupt their formation. Look for an angle to throw an enemy carry toward your team with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. After engaging, keep using Zac W Unstable Matter and collect blobs to survive.
Shyvana.watch: Shyvana Q Emberstrike and Shyvana E Molten Burst deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay close and take repeated hits. Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is unstoppable while she flies in, so hit her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot after she lands. Don’t start an objective if Shyvana’s Fury bar is full.

Skarner.build: First decide whether you need to remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If you do, the listed options are Quicksilver Sash and Mercurial Scimitar. For defenses, prioritize magic resistance, considering Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner W Seismic Bastion. Since he deals damage based on your max health, avoid relying on a large health increase alone.
Skarner.combo: After Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up and hit him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, auto-attack them to throw both enemies into each other and knock them up.
