In a teamfight, follow immediately after landing with Zac R Let's Bounce! and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Skarner.escape: Right after making Skarner use E Ixtal's Impact is your window to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If you let Skarner slam you into a wall with E Ixtal's Impact, he can engage again soon, so back off. When retreating, you can also move away while throwing Zac Q Stretching Strikes behind you to slow pursuers.
Skarner.fight: Right after making Skarner use E Ixtal's Impact, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and grab him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. Avoid angles where Skarner can catch and stun you near a wall.
Skarner.laning: Early on, focus on clearing camps safely and keeping your level even rather than forcing kills. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall outside enemy vision. After your ally draws the enemy forward with a trade, aim for where they’re about to stand. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, engage during that window.
Skarner.phase: Early Zac has little kill pressure and damage, so grow safely.
Skarner.teamfight: Land on the enemy back line with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock them up, then scatter the formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! Use Zac Q Stretching Strikes to set up a throw that sends an enemy carry toward your allies, and use Zac W Unstable Matter during Zac R Let's Bounce! Position yourself outside the short range of Skarner R Impale, and after engaging, stay alive by collecting blobs.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact stuns you when he slams you into a wall and becomes available again sooner, so don’t stand with your back to a wall. Skarner R Impale suppresses you, which Zac E Elastic Slingshot cannot remove, so avoid getting caught at close range. Stay outside melee range so you don’t keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.

Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. If the enemy team's magic damage is high, get Spirit Visage earlier to increase the healing from your blobs as well.
Taliyah.combo: From an angle that avoids rocky ground, land on Taliyah with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock her up, then follow immediately with Zac R Let's Bounce! Keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing. If another enemy is near Taliyah, hit her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, then auto-attack the other enemy to knock them both up. If she’s alone, use it to slow her.
Taliyah.escape: Look for an opening before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back up. Don’t go in as soon as Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down; check her remaining escape options and the rocky ground’s position, then approach with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Taliyah W Seismic Shove can interrupt Zac E Elastic Slingshot with its knock-up or stun, so choose your charging spot carefully.
Taliyah.fight: Early on, don’t force kills. Clear camps safely and keep your level even. If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth isn’t laid down and Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is unavailable, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and grab her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
Taliyah.laning: When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall outside enemy vision and aim for where Taliyah is about to stand. It’s safer to engage after your ally draws her forward with a trade. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, she may gank another lane, so back off in advance.
Taliyah.phase: Early Zac has little kill pressure and damage, so clear camps safely and watch for Taliyah’s fast ganks on other lanes. Once you have more items, Zac W Unstable Matter’s area damage and blob healing improve your staying power in teamfights.
Taliyah.teamfight: Land near Taliyah’s back line with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and scatter the formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! Use Zac Q Stretching Strikes to set up a throw that sends an enemy carry toward your allies, and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter during Zac R Let's Bounce! After engaging, stay alive by collecting blobs, but don’t force an engage when your revive passive is unavailable.
Taliyah.watch: Avoid entering over rocky ground with Zac E Elastic Slingshot, as it can stun you; take a route around it. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change its cast direction, so sidestep it.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage. If Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s magic damage is high, get Spirit Visage earlier to gain magic resistance and increase healing from Zac P Cell Division. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on a large health increase alone.
Udyr.combo: After making Udyr use E Blazing Stampede, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up and grab him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, auto-attack that enemy to make Udyr, who was hit by Zac Q Stretching Strikes, collide with them and knock both up again. When engaging in a teamfight, immediately follow the landing of Zac E Elastic Slingshot with Zac R Let's Bounce! and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Udyr.escape: Udyr E Blazing Stampede is his main mobility tool, so right after making him use it is your window to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. If you’ve already taken the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, use the period when the same target can’t be stunned again for a while. Immobilizing effects don’t work during the awakened effect, so grab him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot after it ends.
Udyr.fight: Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, keep pressuring him with Zac W Unstable Matter so he has no time to heal. If you’ve already weathered one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, use the time it gives you to counterattack or escape. During the fight, collect blobs created by your abilities right away to heal, then use Zac W Unstable Matter again.
Udyr.laning: Early Zac has little kill pressure, so clear camps safely and keep your level even. Vision at key paths and jungle entrances is important for tracking Udyr; don’t push forward in lane while he’s missing. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall outside enemy vision. After your ally draws the enemy forward, aim for where they’re about to stand.
Udyr.phase: Early Zac has little kill pressure and damage, so don’t force fights with Udyr; grow safely. Once you have more items, Zac W Unstable Matter’s area damage and blob healing improve your staying power in teamfights.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to burn down Udyr first while he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle active. Land on the enemy back line with Zac E Elastic Slingshot, then immediately scatter the formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! and set up a throw with Zac Q Stretching Strikes that sends an enemy carry toward your allies. After engaging, stay alive by collecting blobs and use Zac W Unstable Matter whenever it’s ready.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede quickly closes the gap and stuns the first target it hits. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your max health, so don’t fight him for long. During the awakened effect of Udyr E Blazing Stampede, immobilizing effects don’t work, so land Zac Q Stretching Strikes and Zac E Elastic Slingshot after the effect ends.

Vi.build: Build armor first because Vi’s main damage is physical. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on your max health and reduces your armor, so be careful about relying on a large health increase alone. Reducing her basic attack damage and attack speed can help reduce the damage you take.
Vi.combo: After Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, land with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock her up and hit her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, auto-attack them to throw the two targets into each other. In a teamfight, immediately follow the landing with Zac R Let's Bounce! and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Vi.escape: Vi Q Vault Breaker is her mobility tool, so right after she uses it is your window to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. While Vi R Cease and Desist is in progress, hold your forced movement and respond with Zac Q Stretching Strikes after she lands and finishes the knock-up.
Vi.fight: Immediately after dodging or making Vi use Q Vault Breaker, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and grab her with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. Don’t rush into a trade right after Vi’s shield activates; fight briefly once the shield is gone.
Vi.laning: Early Zac has little kill pressure and damage, so clear camps safely and keep your level even. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall outside enemy vision and aim for where Vi is about to stand, rather than her current position. If Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, engage during that window.
Vi.phase: Early Zac has little damage and kill pressure, so don’t force fights with Vi; grow safely.
Vi.teamfight: When engaging with Zac E Elastic Slingshot, land on the enemy back line to knock them up rather than on Vi’s front line, then scatter the formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! If Vi R Cease and Desist is aimed at an allied carry, don’t use forced movement while she’s charging; respond after she lands and finishes the knock-up. After engaging, collect blobs and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter.
Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals much more damage when fully charged, so move back or to the side when you see her charging. Don’t try to stop Vi R Cease and Desist with forced movement while she’s charging at you; respond after she lands and finishes the knock-up. Vi W Denting Blows reduces your armor with repeated attacks, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight.

Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. Viego Q Blade of the Ruined King adds damage based on the target’s current health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone. If the duel gets prolonged, consider healing reduction after building resistances.
Viego.combo: While Viego R Heartbreaker is down, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up, then grab him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, auto-attack them to throw the two into each other; if he’s alone, use the slow from Zac Q Stretching Strikes. Follow with Zac R Let's Bounce! and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Viego.escape: Don’t go in just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down. If Viego R Heartbreaker is also unavailable, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and block his escape route with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If Viego W Spectral Maw is charging, sidestep or interrupt it with Zac Q Stretching Strikes before engaging.
Viego.fight: Early on, avoid forced skirmishes and don’t give Viego a kill. If Viego W Spectral Maw is charging, interrupt it with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Look for an opening after Viego R Heartbreaker is also down.
Viego.laning: When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall outside enemy vision and aim for where Viego is about to stand. It’s safer to go in after your ally draws him forward with a trade. Don’t push the lane in the direction where Viego E Harrowed Path is visible; avoid that path or use a Control Ward.
Viego.phase: Early Zac has little kill pressure and damage, so clear camps safely, keep your level even, and focus on not giving Viego a kill.
Viego.teamfight: Land on the enemy back line with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock them up, then scatter the formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! Use Zac Q Stretching Strikes to set up a throw that sends an enemy carry toward your allies, and use Zac W Unstable Matter during Zac R Let's Bounce! If an ally is killed, knock Viego away from or lock him down at the spot so he can’t reach the lingering wraith there, and stay alive by collecting blobs.
Viego.watch: The stun from Viego W Spectral Maw lasts longer the more he charges it, so sidestep when you see him charging and interrupt it with Zac Q Stretching Strikes or Zac E Elastic Slingshot. When your health is low, you may be targeted by Viego R Heartbreaker, so don’t fight while too far from your allies.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress, and get Spirit Visage earlier. Spirit Visage also increases the healing Zac gets from blobs. Armor is also effective against Warwick’s basic attacks. If a prolonged duel means you need to reduce his healing, consider Executioner's Calling after building resistances.
Warwick.combo: After the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl goes off, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and knock him up before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up. Then hit him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, auto-attack them to throw the two into each other. In a teamfight, use Zac R Let's Bounce! right after landing and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
Warwick.escape: Don’t go in immediately just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Warwick can escape with his remaining mobility, so look especially for a window before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up. Once the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl has gone off, engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and grab him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
Warwick.fight: Back off while Warwick E Primal Howl is active, then move back in after the fear goes off. Before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and grab him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes.
Warwick.laning: Early Zac has little kill pressure, so clear camps safely and keep your level even. When ganking, charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot behind a wall outside enemy vision. After your ally draws the enemy forward, aim for where they’re about to stand. If health has fallen below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt makes pursuit easier, so give up some farm and recall.
Warwick.phase: Early Zac has little damage and kill pressure, so clear camps safely and don’t give Warwick a kill.
Warwick.teamfight: Land near the enemy back line with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock them up, then immediately scatter the formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! If you’ve grabbed an enemy carry with Zac Q Stretching Strikes, look for an angle to throw them toward your allies using another enemy. If Warwick R Infinite Duress hits an ally, focus your counterattack on Warwick while he’s locked down. After engaging, collect blobs and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter.
Warwick.watch: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and follows up with a fear, so don’t focus damage into him or stay close during that time. Warwick R Infinite Duress can suppress a target with a long-range dash, so keep plenty of distance from Warwick when his movement speed is increased. When health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals the affected champion’s position and strengthens his pursuit.

XinZhao.build: Build armor first against Xin Zhao’s main damage. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, and a large health increase alone leaves you vulnerable to damage based on current health from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard.
XinZhao.combo: Right after Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, land with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock him up and slow him with Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If another enemy is nearby, hit Xin Zhao with Q, then auto-attack the other enemy to throw them into each other. In a teamfight, immediately follow the landing with Zac R Let's Bounce! and keep using Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing.
XinZhao.escape: Right after making Xin Zhao use E Audacious Charge is your opportunity to engage with Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Conversely, use Zac E Elastic Slingshot to get out of range before the third attack from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike lands.
XinZhao.fight: Early on, clear camps safely and keep your level even instead of forcing fights. If Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, close the gap with Zac E Elastic Slingshot and grab him with the slow from Zac Q Stretching Strikes. If Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, wait out its immunity before counterattacking.
XinZhao.laning: When ganking, first find a spot behind a wall outside enemy vision to charge Zac E Elastic Slingshot. After your ally draws Xin Zhao forward with a trade, aim for where he’s about to stand and engage.
XinZhao.phase: Early Zac has little kill pressure and damage, so clear camps safely and keep your level even.
XinZhao.teamfight: If Xin Zhao is likely to engage, don’t stand right next to your allies. Land on the enemy back line with Zac E Elastic Slingshot to knock them up, then scatter the formation with Zac R Let's Bounce! and use Zac W Unstable Matter while bouncing. After engaging, collect blobs right away to stay alive, then target Xin Zhao once Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.watch: Dodge the follow-up thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving to the side. If you’ve been hit twice by Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s empowered attacks, use Zac E Elastic Slingshot to create distance before the third knock-up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don’t deal damage from outside spear range; wait for its duration to end.
